title: Support draft activity must return a blocked draft on its last attempt, never raise
answers: Support ticket stuck on Processing after draft agent fails
Why does the draft activity return a blocked_on_knowledge draft instead of raising?
Ticket stays in_progress after AI reply draft fails
body:
The draft activity may raise only while a retry remains. On the final attempt it must return a draft with confidence 0.0 and verdict `blocked_on_knowledge`, so the ticket never auto-sends and a person picks it up.
- Enforced in `products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_give_up`. It raises `DraftNotProducedError` while `llm_attempts() < DRAFT_ACTIVITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS`, and otherwise returns the blocked draft.
- If the last attempt raises, the workflow fails before it records a result and the ticket stays `in_progress` (shown as "Processing").
- The retry limit is the `DRAFT_ACTIVITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` constant in `products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/constants.py`. `pipeline.py` uses it in `RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=...)`. Keep the two in sync. The value stays 2 so workflow replay is unchanged.
- Every new failure path in `_draft_async` should go through `_give_up`.
applies: products/conversations ai_reply draft activity and its Temporal retry policy in pipeline.py
